citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

description.en: The fourteen domains of the refined Theoretical Domains Framework, a synthesis of 33 behaviour-change theories into a set of domains for identifying the determinants of professional behaviour. Included as a second worked example because, unlike the built-in Responsible Innovation framework, it was designed from the outset as a coding frame for interview data: Atkins et al. (2017) set out how to code transcripts against these domains and how to judge domain relevance. It also differs structurally in two ways that matter for a pluggability claim — fourteen dimensions rather than four, and no polarity model, so codes collapse from DIM-P / DIM-N to DIM and the polarity sub-tab disappears from the interface. Barrier/enabler coding is common TDF practice and can be added by giving this file a polarity block; it is deliberately left out here so that one shipped framework exercises the no-polarity path.
description.zh: 精煉版理論領域框架的十四個領域，把 33 個行為改變理論綜合成一組用於辨識專業行為決定因素的領域。收錄為第二個示範框架的理由是：與內建的負責任創新框架不同，它從一開始就是**為了編碼訪談資料而設計的**——Atkins 等人（2017）明確寫出如何拿逐字稿對這些領域編碼、如何判定領域是否相關。它在結構上也有兩點與預設框架不同，而那兩點正是可插拔主張需要的：十四個維度而不是四個、而且沒有極性模型，因此編碼會從 DIM-P／DIM-N 收合成 DIM，介面上的極性子頁籤也會消失。以障礙／助力（barrier／enabler）當極性是 TDF 的常見作法，只要在這個檔案加一個 polarity 區塊就能啟用；這裡刻意不加，是為了讓發行的框架裡有一個走無極性路徑。

descriptor_source.en: the respondent's self-introduction and any statement of their role, setting and length of experience
descriptor_source.zh: 受訪者的自我介紹，以及任何關於職務、場域與年資的陳述

definition.en: An awareness of the existence of something: knowledge of the procedure, of the evidence behind it, or of the task environment.
definition.zh: 對某事物存在的知悉：對程序本身的知識、對其背後證據的知識，或對任務環境的知識。

en: stating what the guideline, procedure or evidence says
reporting not having known something until a particular point
describing where knowledge came from (training, colleagues, reading)
distinguishing what is known from what is assumed
zh: 陳述指引、程序或證據的內容
表示在某個時點之前並不知道某件事
說明知識的來源（訓練、同事、閱讀）
區分「知道的」與「以為的」

en: Believing one is able to do something is Beliefs about Capabilities, not Knowledge.
Knowing how to perform a procedure through practice is Skills, not Knowledge.
Do not code a passage as Knowledge merely because it contains factual content; the passage must be about the respondent's awareness.
zh: 相信自己做得到屬於能力信念，不是知識。
透過練習而會做某個程序屬於技能，不是知識。
不可以因為段落含有事實性內容就編為知識；段落必須談的是受訪者的知悉狀態。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

Atkins, L., Francis, J., Islam, R., O'Connor, D., Patey, A., Ivers, N., Foy, R., Duncan, E. M., Colquhoun, H., Grimshaw, J. M., Lawton, R., & Michie, S. (2017). A guide to using the Theoretical Domains Framework of behaviour change to investigate implementation problems. Implementation Science, 12, 77.

definition.en: An ability or proficiency acquired through practice, including the competence to carry out the behaviour and the practice needed to maintain it.
definition.zh: 經由練習獲得的能力或熟練度，包含執行該行為的勝任程度，以及維持它所需的練習。

en: describing having learned to do something by doing it
reporting skill decay or the need for refresher practice
assessment or supervision of competence
describing the difference between knowing and being able to do
zh: 描述靠實作學會某件事
提到技能生疏或需要複訓
對勝任度的評估或督導
描述「知道」與「做得到」的差別

en: Confidence in one's ability is Beliefs about Capabilities; Skills is about the ability itself.
Lacking the equipment to practise is Environmental Context and Resources.
Awareness that a technique exists is Knowledge.
zh: 對自身能力的信心屬於能力信念；技能談的是能力本身。
缺乏練習所需的設備屬於環境脈絡與資源。
知道有某種技術存在屬於知識。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: A coherent set of behaviours and displayed personal qualities of an individual in a social or work setting: what the respondent takes to be part of their job, and what kind of professional they take themselves to be.
definition.zh: 個人在社會或工作場域中一組連貫的行為與展現出的特質：受訪者認為什麼是自己的分內工作，以及認為自己是哪一種專業人員。

en: stating that something is or is not part of one's job
boundary work between professions ("that's the nurses' side")
appeals to professional identity or standards as a reason
describing a change in what the role is taken to cover
zh: 陳述某件事是不是自己的分內工作
專業之間的界線劃分（「那是護理端的事」）
以專業身分或專業標準當作理由
描述角色涵蓋範圍的改變

en: What other people expect of the respondent is Social Influences; this domain is about the respondent's own account of their role.
Being formally required to do something by the organisation is Environmental Context and Resources unless the respondent frames it as identity.
Do not infer role identity from job title alone; the passage must voice it.
zh: 別人對受訪者的期待屬於社會影響；這個領域談的是受訪者自己對角色的陳述。
組織形式上要求做某件事屬於環境脈絡與資源，除非受訪者以認同的語言陳述它。
不可以只憑職稱推論角色認同；段落必須自己說出來。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: Acceptance of the truth, reality or validity about an ability, talent or facility that a person can put to constructive use — self-efficacy and perceived behavioural control.
definition.zh: 對自己所具備、可建設性運用的能力或天賦的真實性所持的接受態度——即自我效能與知覺行為控制。

en: expressed confidence or doubt about being able to do it
reference to how difficult the behaviour is for this respondent
comparison with others' ability
describing what would have to be true for them to manage it
zh: 表達對自己做得到與否的信心或懷疑
提到這個行為對自己而言有多難
與他人能力的比較
說明要具備什麼條件自己才應付得來

en: Actual demonstrated ability is Skills; this domain is about the belief.
General positive outlook about outcomes is Optimism.
Believing the behaviour will produce a good result is Beliefs about Consequences.
zh: 實際展現出來的能力屬於技能；這個領域談的是信念。
對結果的一般性樂觀屬於樂觀。
相信該行為會產生好結果屬於結果信念。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.
Bandura, A. (1977). Self-efficacy: Toward a unifying theory of behavioral change. Psychological Review, 84(2), 191-215.

definition.en: The confidence that things will happen for the best or that desired goals will be attained — a general disposition rather than a judgement about one specific behaviour.
definition.zh: 相信事情會往好的方向發展、期望的目標會達成的信心——是一種一般性的傾向，而不是對某個特定行為的判斷。

en: general expressions that things will work out, or will not
pessimism about the setting or the system as a whole
expectation that difficulties will resolve over time
a stated outlook that is not tied to one particular action
zh: 一般性地表示事情會好轉，或不會
對整個場域或制度的悲觀
預期困難會隨時間化解
不繫於任何單一行動的整體展望

en: A prediction about what one specific action will achieve is Beliefs about Consequences.
Confidence in one's own ability is Beliefs about Capabilities.
This domain is frequently over-applied: code it only when the passage voices a general outlook. Pleasant tone is not optimism.
zh: 對某個特定行動會達成什麼的預測屬於結果信念。
對自身能力的信心屬於能力信念。
這個領域很常被濫用：只有在段落真的表達了一般性展望時才編。語氣愉快不是樂觀。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: Acceptance of the truth, reality or validity about outcomes of a behaviour in a given situation — what the respondent expects to follow from doing or not doing it.
definition.zh: 對某一行為在特定情境下會產生什麼結果的接受態度——受訪者預期做或不做會帶來什麼。

en: stated expectations about what the behaviour will achieve
perceived risks, costs or harms of doing it
weighing benefits against costs
beliefs about consequences for patients, clients or colleagues
zh: 陳述對該行為會達成什麼的預期
知覺到做這件事的風險、成本或損害
權衡利益與成本
對病患、客戶或同事會有什麼後果的信念

en: Rewards and penalties that actually followed are Reinforcement; this domain is the belief beforehand.
A general sense that things will be fine is Optimism.
Emotional reactions to an anticipated outcome are Emotion; the belief and the feeling are separate codes.
zh: 實際發生過的獎懲屬於增強；這個領域談的是事前的信念。
泛泛地覺得事情會沒事屬於樂觀。
對預期結果的情緒反應屬於情緒；信念與感受是兩個不同的碼。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: Increasing the probability of a response by arranging a dependent relationship between the response and a given stimulus: incentives, rewards, sanctions and their contingencies.
definition.zh: 藉由在反應與特定刺激之間建立依賴關係，來提高該反應出現的機率：誘因、獎勵、制裁及其權變關係。

en: financial or non-financial incentives attached to the behaviour
audit, feedback or performance monitoring with consequences
sanctions, penalties or the absence of any consequence
describing how past consequences changed subsequent behaviour
zh: 與該行為掛勾的金錢或非金錢誘因
帶有後果的稽核、回饋或績效監控
制裁、罰則，或根本沒有任何後果
描述過去的後果如何改變了後續行為

en: An expectation about consequences that have not occurred is Beliefs about Consequences.
Colleagues' approval as a motivator is Social Influences unless it is an arranged contingency.
Resource availability is Environmental Context and Resources.
zh: 對尚未發生的後果的預期屬於結果信念。
以同事認可作為動機屬於社會影響，除非那是被安排出來的權變關係。
資源是否可得屬於環境脈絡與資源。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: A conscious decision to perform a behaviour or a resolve to act in a certain way — a stated commitment, not a specific plan.
definition.zh: 有意識地決定執行某個行為，或決心以某種方式行動——是一種表明的承諾，不是具體計畫。

en: stating a decision to do or not do something
expressed willingness or unwillingness
describing having changed one's mind
commitment stated without a specific plan attached
zh: 陳述決定要做或不做某件事
表達願意或不願意
描述自己改變了想法
只有承諾、沒有附帶具體計畫

en: A specific target with a time frame or priority ordering is Goals.
Concrete if-then planning or self-monitoring is Behavioural Regulation.
Believing the behaviour is worthwhile is Beliefs about Consequences, not an intention to do it.
zh: 帶有時程或優先順序的具體標的屬於目標。
具體的「若…則…」規劃或自我監控屬於行為調節。
認為該行為值得做屬於結果信念，不等於有意圖去做。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: Mental representations of outcomes or end states that an individual wants to achieve, including how they are prioritised against competing goals.
definition.zh: 個人想要達成的結果或終局狀態的心理表徵，包含它們與其他競爭目標之間的優先順序。

en: a stated target, standard or end state to be reached
ranking this behaviour against competing demands
describing goal conflict between clinical, financial or personal aims
distinguishing what matters most from what is merely desirable
zh: 陳述要達到的標的、標準或終局狀態
把這個行為與其他競爭需求排序
描述臨床、財務或個人目標之間的衝突
區分最要緊的與只是想要的

en: A bare decision to act, with no target or priority, is Intentions.
Targets imposed and enforced by the organisation with consequences are Reinforcement.
The means by which a goal is pursued is Behavioural Regulation.
zh: 只是決定要行動、沒有標的或優先順序，屬於意圖。
組織強制施加並帶有後果的指標屬於增強。
追求目標所用的手段屬於行為調節。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: The ability to retain information, focus selectively on aspects of the environment, and choose between two or more alternatives.
definition.zh: 保留資訊、選擇性地專注於環境中某些面向，以及在兩個以上選項之間做出抉擇的能力。

en: forgetting to do it, or relying on prompts and reminders
competing demands on attention during the task
describing how a judgement between options was made
the behaviour described as automatic or as requiring deliberation
zh: 忘記做，或依賴提示與提醒
執行任務時注意力被其他事情競逐
描述如何在選項之間做出判斷
把該行為描述為自動化的，或需要刻意思考的

en: Not knowing what to do is Knowledge, not forgetting.
Interruptions caused by the physical setting are Environmental Context and Resources; this domain is the cognitive effect of them.
A checklist or reminder system the respondent set up deliberately is Behavioural Regulation.
zh: 不知道該怎麼做屬於知識，不是忘記。
實體環境造成的中斷屬於環境脈絡與資源；這個領域談的是它造成的認知效果。
受訪者刻意建立的查核表或提醒機制屬於行為調節。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: Any circumstance of a person's situation or environment that discourages or encourages the behaviour, including physical resources, staffing, time, organisational culture and regulatory context.
definition.zh: 個人所處情境或環境中任何會阻礙或促進該行為的條件，包含實體資源、人力、時間、組織文化與法規環境。

en: availability of equipment, systems, funding or staffing
time pressure and workload
organisational culture, policy or regulatory requirement
physical layout or workflow that makes the behaviour easier or harder
zh: 設備、系統、經費或人力是否可得
時間壓力與工作負荷
組織文化、政策或法規要求
使該行為變得容易或困難的空間配置或流程

en: This is the most over-applied domain in TDF coding, because almost every account mentions circumstances. Code it only when the circumstance is offered as bearing on the behaviour, not merely as background description.
What colleagues or managers expect is Social Influences, even when it is part of the culture.
The respondent's own workload management strategies are Behavioural Regulation.
zh: 這是 TDF 編碼中最常被濫用的領域，因為幾乎每段話都會提到情境。只有在該情境被當成與行為有關而提出時才編，單純的背景描述不算。
同事或主管的期待屬於社會影響，即使那是文化的一部分。
受訪者自己管理工作量的策略屬於行為調節。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

Atkins, L., Francis, J., Islam, R., O'Connor, D., Patey, A., Ivers, N., Foy, R., Duncan, E. M., Colquhoun, H., Grimshaw, J. M., Lawton, R., & Michie, S. (2017). A guide to using the Theoretical Domains Framework of behaviour change to investigate implementation problems. Implementation Science, 12, 77.

definition.en: Interpersonal processes that can cause an individual to change their thoughts, feelings or behaviours: norms, pressure, modelling, support and conflict.
definition.zh: 會使個人改變想法、感受或行為的人際歷程：規範、壓力、示範、支持與衝突。

en: what colleagues, managers, patients or clients expect
observing and following what others do
support, encouragement or discouragement from others
conflict or negotiation with another group
zh: 同事、主管、病患或客戶的期待
觀察並跟隨他人的作法
來自他人的支持、鼓勵或勸阻
與另一群體的衝突或協商

en: The respondent's own account of what their job covers is Social/professional role and identity.
Formal organisational requirements are Environmental Context and Resources unless voiced as interpersonal expectation.
Arranged incentives and sanctions are Reinforcement.
zh: 受訪者自己對職務範圍的陳述屬於社會／專業角色與認同。
正式的組織要求屬於環境脈絡與資源，除非是以人際期待的方式說出來。
被安排出來的誘因與制裁屬於增強。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: A complex reaction pattern involving experiential, behavioural and physiological elements, by which the individual attempts to deal with a personally significant matter or event.
definition.zh: 一種涉及經驗、行為與生理成分的複雜反應型態，個人藉此應對對自己而言重要的事件。

en: named feelings about the behaviour or its context (anxiety, frustration, relief)
stress, burnout or emotional exhaustion
fear of a specific consequence
describing how a feeling affected what was done
zh: 指名對該行為或其脈絡的感受（焦慮、挫折、鬆一口氣）
壓力、耗竭或情緒耗損
對某個特定後果的恐懼
描述某種感受如何影響了實際作為

en: A belief that something bad will happen is Beliefs about Consequences; code Emotion only when a feeling is voiced.
General outlook without a named feeling is Optimism.
Do not infer emotion from tone of voice or word choice alone — the transcript must state it.
zh: 認為壞事會發生屬於結果信念；只有在感受被說出來時才編情緒。
沒有指名感受的整體展望屬於樂觀。
不可以單憑語氣或用詞推論情緒——逐字稿必須明白說出來。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

definition.en: Anything aimed at managing or changing objectively observed or measured actions: self-monitoring, action planning, and the deliberate structuring of one's own behaviour.
definition.zh: 任何用來管理或改變可客觀觀察、測量之行動的作為：自我監控、行動規劃，以及刻意為自身行為建立結構。

en: self-monitoring, recording or reviewing one's own performance
action planning or if-then rules the respondent set for themselves
checklists, routines or habits deliberately established
describing how a new practice was embedded into the working day
zh: 自我監控、記錄或檢視自己的表現
受訪者為自己訂下的行動計畫或「若…則…」規則
刻意建立的查核表、例行程序或習慣
描述如何把新作法嵌進日常工作

en: Monitoring imposed by the organisation with consequences attached is Reinforcement.
A decision to act, with no mechanism, is Intentions.
A reminder system supplied by the employer is Environmental Context and Resources; this domain is what the respondent does themselves.
zh: 組織施加且帶有後果的監控屬於增強。
只有決定要行動、沒有任何機制，屬於意圖。
雇主提供的提醒系統屬於環境脈絡與資源；這個領域談的是受訪者自己做的事。

literature.citation: Cane, J., O'Connor, D., & Michie, S. (2012). Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research. Implementation Science, 7, 37.

Michie, S., Johnston, M., Abraham, C., Lawton, R., Parker, D., & Walker, A. (2005). Making psychological theory useful for implementing evidence based practice: A consensus approach. Quality and Safety in Health Care, 14(1), 26-33.
